question: What topics are included in the discussion of daily worship and its supports?
premises: The discussion includes the purpose of daily worship for one who still has remaining duties.
It includes supreme worship on the ritual ground and the nature of the liṅga.
It also includes a many-sided explanation of the rosary.
inference: The section treats daily worship together with its purpose, setting, liṅga, and rosary.
uncertainties: śeṣavṛtteḥ is terse and may refer to a householder or one with continuing obligations.
plain_english: This section will explain the purpose of daily worship for one who still has duties, supreme worship on the ritual ground, the nature of the liṅga in many ways, and the meaning of the rosary.
